landing_claim: The daily desk for data protection and AI law.
landing_intro: Daily gathers what data protection officers, AI officers and auditors need every day: the latest decisions of supervisory authorities and courts, a notebook that attaches to them, and tools that turn each duty under the GDPR and the AI Act into a documented result.
landing_status: The platform grows one tool at a time.
landing_read_body: One digest per day: EDPB, BfDI, German state authorities, CJEU, Official Journal. Every entry carries the provision it touches. Five minutes over coffee is enough to stay current.
landing_note_body: One note per day, linked to the items, deadlines and assessments it concerns. Full-text search across everything you have ever written down.
landing_work_body: Tools for concrete duties: AI Act risk class, DPIA screening, the 72-hour breach clock, data subject requests. Every result cites its legal basis and prints cleanly.
tools_intro: Each tool answers one concrete question from practice, cites its legal basis and produces a documented result. Planned tools appear here as they are finished.
tools_pin_hint: Use the pin icon on a tool to keep it here.
form_saved_note: The result is stored with date and catalog version and can be printed.
run_disclaimer: The assessment rests solely on the answers given.
feed_intro: What supervisory authorities, courts, legislators and the legal press published today on data protection and AI law. Title, excerpt and link only; the text stays with the source.
feed_empty: No entries for this selection in the period.
check_not_saved: This result is not saved. With an account, assessments are stored with date and catalog version.
check_noscript: The evaluation runs in your browser and needs JavaScript.
preview_notice: Public preview. Sign-in and saved assessments are switched off here; entries and notes stay in your browser.
preview_intro: This version of Daily is a static preview. It runs without a server, database or sign-in and is rebuilt several times a day.
preview_works_feed: News: every rebuild fetches and tags the sources afresh. Filtering happens in your browser.
preview_works_tools: Tools: assessments and developer tools (repository check, guardrail test) run entirely in the browser. Answers and files never leave the page.
preview_works_records: Registers and workflows: record of processing activities, DPIA, data subject requests, personal data breach, processor contracts, TOM catalogue, retention schedule, training log, AI system register, AI literacy, serious incident reports, fundamental rights impact assessment, audit programme, audit checklist, findings and audit report with history, links, deadlines, CSV and calendar export. Entries are kept only in this browser's storage, never transmitted, and can be deleted there at any time.
preview_works_lang: German and English, light and dark paper.
preview_missing_body: Sign-in through Keycloak, client organisations, registers in Postgres with authors in the history and shared editing, saved and printable assessments with catalog version, bookmarks and the notebook. That needs a server with Postgres and Keycloak.
records_copy_note: Description, scope and links are taken over. Dates, attached check results and checklist answers are not: they belong to the original entry.
records_example_note: A made-up example to look at and adapt. Replace it with your own details before saving.
records_lesson_note: Title, topic, today’s date, format and audience come from the training module. Add participants, number and evidence; change the date if the session was on another day.
records_archive_confirm: The entry leaves the list but is kept with its history (Art. 5(2) GDPR).
records_conflict: The entry was changed in the meantime. Your input is kept below: saving overwrites the new version, "Load newest version" discards your input.
records_not_allowed: This step is not possible in the current status.
records_local: Stored in this browser only. Nothing leaves the device; other browsers and devices do not see these entries.
records_local_clear_confirm: Delete all entries of all tools stored in this browser?
handoff_failed: The result could not be attached.
org_intro: Daily keeps assessments, registers and deadlines apart per organisation. Your own organisation always exists; as an external data protection or AI officer you add clients here and switch between them.
org_name_invalid: Please enter a name of 1 to 120 characters.
normen_intro: The texts of the GDPR, the AI Act, the Data Act, the BDSG, the TDDDG and the BetrVG with cross-references and the tools that cite a provision. Only the versions published in the Official Journal of the EU and the Federal Law Gazette are authentic.
normen_more: The first {count} results; narrow the search.
normen_fallback: There is no official English version; the German text is shown.
notes_intro: Notes on news, provisions and your own cases. They belong to the active organisation; in the public preview they stay in this browser.
notes_text_help: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, - lists, # headings, [link](https://…). Citations such as "Art. 6 DSGVO" or "§ 26 BDSG" become links.
notes_source_help: Link or description of where the note comes from.
reports_intro: Reports for a period from registers, workflows, deadlines and saved assessments, e.g. as the data protection officer’s activity report (Art. 39(1) GDPR). Preface and outlook are not stored, only printed.
reports_summary: {total} entries, of which {created} new and {updated} changed in the period
reports_empty: There are no entries for this report yet.
reports_runs_preview: Saved assessments exist only in the full installation.
records_transition_body: {from} → {to}. The change is recorded in the history.
home_area_tools: Checks, registers and workflows for the GDPR and the AI Act, each citing its legal basis.
home_area_norms: The GDPR, the AI Act, the Data Act, the BDSG, the TDDDG and the BetrVG in full, with cross-references.
home_area_notes: A daily note on news, provisions and your own matters.
home_area_deadlines: Open deadlines from registers and workflows, the nearest first.
records_leave_body: The input in this form has not been saved yet.
form_skipped: Not relevant for the chosen scope.
draft_older: The entry has changed since; saving now overwrites those changes.
check_first_open: Go to the first open question
check_section_skipped: Not asked, given the answers so far.
anon_intro: Paste text or import a file (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV). Personal data is replaced by placeholders; the mapping lives only in this tab's memory and is gone when you close it. Nothing is uploaded and no AI service is called. This is pseudonymisation, not anonymisation: as long as the mapping exists, the data stays personal data (Art. 4(5), recital 26 GDPR).
anon_err_unsupported: {name}: not supported. Use PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD or CSV.
anon_err_no_text: {name} has no text layer, e.g. a scan. Text recognition is not offered here, as it would have to load data from the network.
anon_note: Add a note for the AI
anon_terms_hint: Applies to every text in this browser and is stored only here. One term per line.
anon_terms_always_placeholder:
e.g. Example Ltd
Project Northern Light
anon_suggestions_hint: These words may be names no rule caught. One click replaces them everywhere in the text.
anon_marked_hint: Click a highlight to switch it off or on again. Select a word to replace it.
anon_review_map: Where the findings are in the text
anon_review_keys: The keys J and K move to the next and previous finding. Keeping in the clear applies to every place of this value.
anon_review_empty: Nothing was found in the text.
anon_findings_empty: No personal data found. Names without a title, label or known first name are not detected; mark them by hand.
anon_manual_hint: A selection in the text above or in the text field appears here.
anon_output_hint: Copy this text into the AI chat. It contains placeholders only.
anon_copy_failed: Copying is not possible; select the text and copy it by hand.
anon_reply_hint: Paste the reply here; the placeholders are replaced by the real values.
anon_restored_count: {count} placeholders restored; the mapping knows {total} values.
anon_leftover: Unknown or altered placeholders, please check:
anon_stale: The text changed after copying. The reply is restored with the mapping from the time of copying.
account_intro: What Daily stores about you, and your rights as a user: access, a copy of your data and erasure (Art. 15, 17, 20 GDPR).
account_sessions_note: A session ends after 30 days or on sign-out; expired sessions are deleted daily.
account_export_body: Everything about your account and the full content of the organisations you own, as a JSON file (Art. 15, 20 GDPR). Passwords and sign-in tokens are not included.
account_delete_body: Deletes your account and every organisation only you own, with all entries, histories and deadlines. This cannot be undone; export your data first. Afterwards you confirm at sign-in that your login is deleted too.
account_delete_confirm: Your account and your own organisations with all entries are deleted right away.
account_delete_shared: These organisations have other members: {names}. Transfer ownership first.
account_deleted_body: Your data in Daily has been deleted.
account_deleted_backups: Encrypted backups are overwritten within 30 days and are not used until then.
account_deleted_cancelled: If you cancelled the deletion at sign-in, only your empty login remains. You can delete it under "Account" after signing in again.
legal_operator_missing: The controller's details will be added before launch.
dsfa_tom_unlinked: No TOM catalogue entry linked yet. Choose the system the processing runs on under “Measures in the TOM catalogue”; the measures in place then appear beside the risks, goal by goal.
dsfa_tom_missing: The linked TOM catalogue entry was not found.
dsfa_tom_need: Protection need from the initial risks of this DPIA: {need}; in the TOM catalogue: {tom}.
dsfa_tom_need_low: The TOM catalogue assumes a lower protection need (SDM D3.3); raise the protection need and the measures there.
dsfa_signoff_intro: What DSK Kurzpapier Nr. 5 and the EDPB DPIA template require before processing starts.
aiact_outside: The system falls into no tier of the AI Act.
dsfa_xlsx_failed: The Excel file could not be created.
sdm_progress: {rated} of {total} ratings of goals per level
sdm_focus_none: No gap, and nothing only partly in place.
sdm_focus_more: and {count} more, in the cube and the tables below
sdm3d_label: SDM cube in 3D with {n} cells. The tables below hold the same values.
sdm3d_keys: Drag to turn the cube. Arrow keys choose a cell, Page Up and Down the goal, Enter pulls out the slice.
sdm3d_axes: x: {x} · y: levels 1 to 3 from the top · z: protection goals, goal 1 in front
sdm3d_requirement: What the goal asks for here
sdm3d_empty: Click a cell: its slice slides out of the cube and lies flat here, with what the goal asks for on that level.
sdm3d_rate_hint: Applies to every operation on this level; a gap for a single operation below.
sdm3d_conflict: The entry has changed in the meantime. Reload the page and rate again.
rechtsstand_newer: a newer version of {date} has been imported since
print_policy_draft: Draft, open points in square brackets
print_policy_in_force: This policy enters into force on
print_vvt_controller_name: Name and contact details of the controller
today_due_none: Nothing is overdue, nothing is due this week.
today_cases_none: No open matter, request, breach or finding.
lesson_details_missing: Missing: {list}. Until then a marked placeholder shows.
lesson_end_text: Questions are welcome now. Afterwards record the session so attendance is on file.
lesson_keys: Arrow keys or swipe to move · N notes · F full screen · Esc ends
print_kind_dsfa: Data protection impact assessment under Art. 35 GDPR
tool_retired: This tool has been merged into "{name}". Existing entries and results stay readable; please start new work there.
backup_intro: Every entry with its history, archived ones and the organisation's details included, in one file. Use it to bring the entries back into this or another browser or workspace.
backup_never: No backup has been downloaded from this browser yet.
backup_not_daily: This file is not a Daily backup.
backup_newer: This backup comes from a newer version of Daily and cannot be read here.
backup_counts: In the file: {total} · new: {added} · already here: {present}
backup_keep: Entries already here stay as they are; nothing is overwritten.
backup_nothing: Every entry in the file is already here.
backup_done: Added: {count}. Entries already here are unchanged.
backup_failed: The backup could not be read or added.
demo_done: That's it. Your earlier input is unchanged; the demo saved nothing.
demo_q_intro: You answer each question with yes, no or don't know.
demo_q_answer: One click answers the question. Follow-up questions appear only when they apply.
demo_q_rest: The other questions the same way …
demo_q_submit: “Evaluate” evaluates the answers, in the browser.
demo_q_result: The result: an assessment with reasons and the legal basis.
demo_q_next: Below it: what to do next.
demo_q_print: Print the report or save it as a PDF.
demo_r_intro_example: A new entry, here filled in with the example.
demo_r_intro: A new entry starts with this form.
demo_r_title: First the name of the entry.
demo_r_sections: The sections show what is filled in and what is still missing.
demo_r_result: This is what the saved entry looks like.
demo_r_list: Once saved, the entry is in the list, ready to print and edit.
demo_s_intro: One SDM cube per processing activity, here filled in with the example.
demo_s_rate: Per protection goal and level: in place, partly, gap or not relevant.
demo_s_focus: “Zuerst angehen” ranks the goals by urgency and says why.
demo_s_cube: The cube in 3D: operations × levels × goals. Drag to turn it.
demo_s_views: The buttons show the three SDM views.
demo_s_gaps: “Gaps only” shows exactly where in the cube something is missing.
demo_s_slice: A click on a cell pulls its slice out and lays it flat beside the cube.
demo_s_rate_cube: Rate the cell right here, by click or with the keys 1 to 4.
demo_s_detail: Below: what the goal asks for on this level, and your measures.
demo_l_start: The training runs as a full-screen presentation.
demo_l_next: Next with the arrow key or this button.
demo_l_quiz: After the slides, a quiz checks the key points.
demo_l_answer: After an answer it says why it is right.
demo_l_end: Finally you record the training as evidence.
demo_p_text: Paste a text or load a file, here the example.
demo_p_found: This shows what is detected and how much was found.
demo_p_mark: A click on a mark leaves the value as it is.
demo_p_output: The text with placeholders instead of personal data.
demo_p_copy: Copy it into the AI. Paste the reply below to restore it.
demo_g_sets: Pick the prompt sets and add the canary to the system prompt.
demo_g_reply: I'm sorry, I can't share that.
demo_g_result: The result shows where the bot gives in.
demo_c_files: Choose a folder or files; they stay in the browser.
demo_c_paste: Or paste code, here a call to an AI API.
demo_c_run: “Check” looks for AI services and personal data.
demo_c_result: The result lists every finding with file and line.
